interface.longDescription: Support for Finnish–Swedish bilingualism in legal work: translating legal language and the established terminology FI↔SV from official sources (the parallel texts in Finlex, the Government Term Bank), and linguistic rights and the language obligations of an authority (kielilaki 423/2003, perustuslaki 731/1999 section 17, the Act on the Knowledge of Languages Required of Personnel in Public Bodies 424/2003 and the Sámi Language Act 1086/2003). A term is never invented; an official translation comes from an authorised translator.
